## Scope

This repository is intended as a close WotLK 3.3.5a port of upstream
[Instance Spell Collector](https://github.com/enderneko/InstanceSpellCollector).
New product features should be proposed upstream first.

- [ ] This ports existing upstream behavior.
- [ ] This is required for WotLK 3.3.5a compatibility.
- [ ] This fixes missing or broken backport behavior.

## Upstream reference

Link the relevant upstream file, commit, issue, release, or behavior.

## Problem

Describe the problem or missing behavior.

## Proposed solution

Describe the expected result and any alternatives considered.
